rows.title: CA Industrial Trainee
rows.description_external:
About Zetwerk

Founded in 2018, Zetwerk is a global manufacturing platform that enables businesses to bring world-class products to life through a network of trusted suppliers and cutting-edge technology. As a managed marketplace for contract manufacturing, we connect global enterprises with small and medium manufacturers to deliver high-quality, cost-efficient, and timely solutions.

Our operations span across India, the USA, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East, supported by multiple state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities and a strong network of over 10,000 supplier partners. Together, we serve thousands of customers across industries such as renewable energy, precision engineering, automotive, and electronics - helping them scale their manufacturing capabilities with reliability and precision.

At Zetwerk, technology drives everything we do. Our proprietary Manufacturing Operating System (MOS) digitizes the entire production cycle - from supplier selection and order tracking to real-time quality assurance - enabling faster decision-making, transparency, and efficiency for our clients.

We take pride in contributing to landmark national and global initiatives, from advancing renewable energy and EV infrastructure to supporting defence and high-speed rail projects. Our commitment to innovation and excellence has earned us recognition among India’s strongest engineering brands and as one of the Best Workplaces in Manufacturing.

As we continue to grow, Zetwerk remains focused on empowering manufacturers, creating jobs, and strengthening India’s position as a global manufacturing powerhouse - in line with the vision of Make in India, Digital India, and Startup India.


Pinaka Aerospace, a Zetwerk company, is a leading aerospace and defence technology organization specializing in avionics, communication systems, defence electronics, simulation systems, and advanced engineering solutions. With a strong presence in India's defence and aerospace ecosystem, Pinaka partners with leading defence organizations, research institutions, and industrial customers to develop mission-critical technologies that support national security and aerospace innovation. As part of Zetwerk's Aerospace & Defence business, Pinaka combines deep engineering expertise with large-scale manufacturing capabilities to deliver world-class solutions for India and global markets.


About the Role

Pinaka Aerospace is looking for a highly motivated CA Industrial Trainee to join the Business Finance team. This role offers hands-on exposure to financial planning, business partnering, cost analysis, MIS reporting, budgeting, and strategic decision-making within a fast-growing aerospace and manufacturing environment. The trainee will work closely with finance leaders and cross-functional teams to support business performance and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities

• Support monthly MIS preparation, financial reporting, and management dashboards.

• Assist in budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis for business units and projects.

• Analyze revenue, costs, margins, and profitability across products and programs.

• Partner with operations, procurement, and supply chain teams to track key business metrics.

• Support inventory, working capital, and cash flow analysis.

• Assist in preparation of business cases, investment proposals, and financial models.

• Participate in month-end closing activities, reconciliations, and financial reviews.

• Support internal controls, audits, and compliance-related activities.

• Drive process improvement initiatives through automation and data-driven insights.

About the Role

We are looking for an Assistant Program Manager to drive end-to-end execution of key projects across functions at Zetwerk. This role involves planning, coordinating, and delivering projects within defined timelines and scope while working closely with cross-functional stakeholders. 


Responsibilities:

• Develop detailed project plans outlining tasks, timelines, and resource requirements.

• Coordinate project activities, ensuring timely completion and delivery within scope.

• Act as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.

• Communicate project progress, risks, and issues to ensure transparency and alignment.

• Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks to ensure successful project delivery.

• Implement contingency plans as needed to address unforeseen challenges.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to allocate and manage project resources effectively.

• Implement quality control processes to ensure deliverables meet or exceed client expectations.

• Conduct regular project reviews to assess and improve overall project quality.
